angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 621,956 km at 151.45 pc = 0.05 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 6.6029 +/- 0.0150 mas (same row, RUWE 1.09): 151.45 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.894 +/- 0.056 solar radii from Wirth et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-942 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021ApJ...917L..34W/abstract): 621,956 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.822 +/- 0.0079 solar masses from Wirth et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-942 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021ApJ...917L..34W/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4969 +/- 100 K from Carleo et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of TOI-942 c's parameter set from Carleo et al. 2021 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...645A..71C/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Carleo et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of TOI-942 c's parameter set from Carleo et al. 2021 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...645A..71C/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-942.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.450, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-942 (pscomppars): spectral type K2.5 V, from Carleo et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...645A..71C/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-942 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.221 dex, from Zhou et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021AJ....161....2Z/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-942 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.35853, from Carleo et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...645A..71C/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-942 (pscomppars): age 0.053 Gyr, from Wirth et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021ApJ...917L..34W/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-942 (pscomppars): rotation period 3.39 d, from Carleo et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021A&A...645A..71C/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-942 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 14.24 km/s, from Wirth et al. 2021 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021ApJ...917L..34W/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
